question: What is the meaning of building physics in relation to physical?
description: Building physics is a branch of physics that deals with the physical properties of buildings and their interactions with the environment. It includes the study of energy and thermal performance, heat transfer, and other physical aspects that affect the comfort, efficiency, and sustainability of buildings. In the context of the provided text, building physics is mentioned as one of the physical properties that need to be addressed in the development of materials for a circular economy.
